resolvedQuestions: Q1: Current load paths and costs - seven paths tabled (AGENTS.md 27,012 B resident / 16,384 B as delivered, REPO RULES.md 11,853 B at first write, trigger-matched rules 5.6-11.8 KB each with 3-4 firing, reply-time five 42,811 B, advisor brief ~261 B deduped to ~54 B, spec-gate notice 551 B, session-start recovery UNKNOWN)

Q2: Five options matrixed with five fields each - status quo; resident cards (+2,509 B to +17,882 B); Gate 5 cards (0.7-1.8k tok per fire vs 6.2-8.2k today); hook cards (234-446 tok per card per window); load everything (36.5k tok per load)

Q3: Hook dedup design - directive-lifecycle receipt v2 marker; durable tmpdir store / Pi in-memory / OpenCode epoch map; compaction-boundary resets wired on all six runtimes; Cursor delivery contradicted; transcript-evidence dependency limits once-per-window; delivered-set keying is new work

Q4: Verdict - AGENTS.md carries binding clauses + pointers (never full text, stay inside the delivery budget); Gate 5 loads router + matched cards with full text on demand (~70-80% load reduction); no hook now, future role is action-boundary card delivery on the directive-lifecycle window model with delivered-set keying and boundary-epoch-only suppression

keyFindings.statement: AGENTS.md reaches the model as the session rules block; in this Devin session it was delivered truncated at 16,384 bytes (about 10.6 KB not resident).
REPO RULES.md is the Gate 5 router, loaded on the first write of a session; read-only turns never fire Gate 5.
Trigger-table rule files load per matched action; 3-4 files firing at once is the normal case (~24.7-33.0 KB per load event).
Reply-time five: 42,811 B all five; 18,340 B mandatory two; 29,143 B with handoff at turn end.
Advisor brief ~261 B full / ~54 B deduped per prompt; spec-gate notice 551 B once per session.
Session-start/compaction recovery path exists; size UNKNOWN.
Compaction is the observed natural window boundary: 104 re-reads after a boundary vs 1 within a window.
Gate 5 reach is partial: 14 of 44 sessions read any rule via Read (undercount).

Option 1 status quo: resident ~6.8k tok (4.1k as delivered); per-window fixed loads router ~3.0k + brief ~65 + notice ~138, variable rule loads 6.2-8.2k per fire; silence = nothing fires; model-side dedup only; six runtimes for the brief.
Option 2 resident cards: +2,509 B to +17,882 B; zero per-turn; full text on demand 1.4-3.0k per file; silence model-mediated; reset at compaction; verified delivery only Claude and Devin.
Option 3 Gate 5 cards: 0 resident; per-fire 0.7-1.8k tokens vs 6.2-8.2k today (~70-80% reduction); silence = no trigger match; reaches every runtime Gate 5 reaches.

Option 4 hook cards: 0 resident; measured fire count (orchestrator, 93 of 265 windows load any rule; 3.5 rules avg, median 3, p90 7) puts card delivery at ~820-1,560 tokens in loading windows, ~290-550 averaged across all windows; dedup machinery exists; transcript evidence for dedup proof UNKNOWN outside Claude.
Option 5 load everything: 145,957 B / ~36.5k tokens per load; no silence; no mechanical dedup.
Reset-semantics mismatch: only the directive lifecycle matches 'reset only on a compaction boundary'; the spec-gate marker is session-scoped with different reset events.
The 16,384-byte delivery cap constrains resident-card options in at least this runtime.
Card-size bounds measured: index form 2,509 B total; full card proxy 17,882 B total (935-1,784 B per rule); drafted size UNKNOWN.

Marker: directive-lifecycle receipt v2 (directives/transcriptPath/transcriptHighWaterBytes/storeGeneration/lifecycleEpoch) with proven-repeat suppression; spec-gate field naming is the naming precedent only.

Storage: durable tmpdir store (base dir env or tmpdir()/speckit-advisor), layout directive-lifecycle/<project-hash>/<session-hash>.json plus generation/epoch/poison files; Pi globalThis map; OpenCode epoch map; spec-gate alternative under .skilled/skills/.state/spec-gate/.

Reset: compaction via boundary events from registered owners (session-prime, post-compaction, cursor precompact, codex session-start), transcript shrink, and epoch advance (null session invalidates all).

Coverage: Claude/Devin/Codex/OpenCode/Pi covered; Cursor reset covered but delivery contradicted within the contract; dedup proof needs transcript evidence or delivery stays full every turn (once-per-window not met on transcript-less runtimes).
Design delta: whole-payload equality is the current dedup key; 'a given rule at most once' needs a delivered-card set - new work.
Inherited bounds: race can double-deliver (precedent accepts); kill switches restore full; all uncertainty fails open to full delivery.

Part 1: AGENTS.md carries binding clauses plus pointer lines (the §8 pattern), never full rule text; stay inside the 16,384-byte guaranteed delivery budget. Falsifier: a measured prohibition that moves only when its full text is resident.

Part 2: Gate 5 loads router plus matched cards, full text on demand; ~70-80% load-event reduction at measured bounds; keeps the action key and silence; no new surface. Falsifier: compliance drop, frequent card-insufficient full opens, or cards unbuildable in bands.

Part 3: no hook now; future role is action-boundary card delivery on the directive-lifecycle window model with delivered-set keying and boundary-epoch-only suppression; must not be an always-on constant. Falsifier: a measured Gate 5 miss rate with cost; or transcript evidence everywhere plus the extension built.
Consistency: no reopening of the advisor-pointer or trigger-index refusals; measure-before-build applies to the hook only; concision playbook stays other lineages' scope.

Runtime caps sourced: Claude Code no hard cap on CLAUDE.md (200-line/25KB caps apply to auto-memory MEMORY.md only); Codex project_doc_max_bytes default 32 KiB cumulative across the AGENTS.md chain (local config has no override); Devin 16,384 B observed; Cursor no enforced cap sourced (advisory 500 lines; 1k-char prerelease warning reported as visual bug); OpenCode no byte guard (entire file injected every loop; effective cap = context window); Pi UNKNOWN (no byte cap documented).

Must-carry set vs the smallest cap (16,384 B, ends mid-line 175): inside today - Four Laws 11-18, PLAN-WORKFLOW LOCK 20-30, Comment Hygiene 32-34, Halt Conditions 36-41, gates 49-61/70-77/79-86/93-101, Verification Standards 151-161, Final-State Verification 165-170; outside today - section 8 pointer line 261 and clauses 263, section 10 mandates 281, 285.
Orchestrator's measured fire count: 93 of 265 compaction windows load any rule (35%); 3.5 distinct rules average, median 3, p90 7; supersedes the option-4 per-window UNKNOWN.
